title: Lop Blocks and Swords
description: Beautiful custom textures for Minecraft blocks and swords
body:
Welcome to Lop Blocks and Swords! 
This custom resource pack updates Minecraft textures with a fresh and clean style. 

What's inside:
- Beautiful custom textures for all swords (Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite).
- Brand new textures for Stone and Grass blocks on the surface.
- Completely reskinned basic ores in stone to match the new look.
